message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/openssl && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"apps/s_client.c","function":"s_client_main","line":0,"var":"input file","code":"The client utility reads a caller-supplied test case / server transcript from standard input or a file via the fuzz harness","note":"Attacker-controlled network transcript drives the TLS client state machine."},
  {"step":2,"file":"ssl/statem/statem_clnt.c","function":"ossl_statem_client_read_transition","line":0,"var":"TLS handshake state","code":"The client processes the incoming handshake messages and advances through client-side state transitions","note":"Malformed handshake data influences certificate and key handling during client setup."},
  {"step":3,"file":"ssl/ssl_lib.c","function":"SSL_do_handshake","line":3791,"var":"s->handshake_func","code":"SSL_do_handshake dispatches into the client handshake implementation","note":"This is the entry into the vulnerable handshake path exercised by the fuzz target."},
  {"step":4,"file":"ssl/s3_lib.c","function":"ssl_generate_pkey_group","line":4720,"var":"dh","code":"For FFDHE groups the code allocates a DH object and assigns it into an EVP_PKEY","note":"The handshake creates and owns a legacy DH key object as part of key exchange setup."},
  {"step":5,"file":"ssl/s3_lib.c","function":"ssl_generate_pkey_group","line":4741,"var":"dh","code":"If EVP_PKEY_assign fails, the error path calls DH_free(dh) before jumping to cleanup","note":"Ownership is released on an error path while later cleanup can still reference the same legacy key container."},
  {"step":6,"file":"crypto/dh/dh_lib.c","function":"DH_free","line":121,"var":"r->references","code":"DH_free decrements the reference count and destroys the DH object when it reaches zero","note":"The object becomes freed, setting up the use-after-free condition if another reference is retained."},
  {"step":7,"file":"ssl/ssl_lib.c","function":"SSL_free","line":1151,"var":"s->cert->dh_tmp","code":"Connection teardown later drops remaining references during SSL cleanup","note":"Cleanup re-enters legacy key teardown after the handshake error path already freed the same object."},
  {"step":8,"file":"crypto/dh/dh_lib.c","function":"DH_free","line":128,"var":"CRYPTO_DOWN_REF","code":"A second DH_free reaches CRYPTO_DOWN_REF on an already freed object and writes through the stale pointer","note":"This is the memory-safety sink: a heap-use-after-free write in the DH reference-count decrement path."}
]
p.write_text('[\n' + ',\n'.join(__import__('json').dumps(x) for x in trace) + '\n]\n')
PY
cat /workspace/candidate_trace.json` executed with exit code 0.
